def export_user_data(user_id, output_path):
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute('SELECT id, username, email, created_at FROM users WHERE id=?', (user_id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        user_data = {'id': row[0], 'username': row[1], 'email': row[2], 'created_at': row[3]}
    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', delete=False, suffix='.json')
    try: os.chmod(tmp.name, 0o600)
    except Exception: pass
    with open(tmp.name, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(user_data, f)
    out_path = Path(output_path)
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(tmp.name, out_path)
    return str(tmp.name)

    if API_KEY is None: logger.warning('API_KEY not set; skipping notification to %s', email); return False
    # rate limiting and HTTPS POST with timeout
